name: Kodan, Hobgoblin Conqueror

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

items.name: Scale Armor
items.description:
Overlapping pieces of highly durable material, such as steel or even dragon scales, make up scale armor. Despite its heaviness, scale is surprisingly easy to wear; its straps and buckles make it adjustable and able to fit snugly on the body, allowing for flexibility and agility.
	Magic appears at higher item levels, and grants higher armor bonuses than its mundane counterparts. Scale armor grants +8 AC at levels 6-10, +9 AC at levels 11-15, +10 AC at levels 16-20, +11 AC at levels 21-25, and +13 AC at levels 26-30.

items.name: Heavy Shield
items.description: While you’re using a heavy shield, you can’t use your shield hand for any other task, since you must use that hand to handle the shield.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Lead from the Front
traits.details: When Kodan hits an enemy with a melee attack, his allies gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls against that enemy until end of Kodan’s next turn.

effect.description: Kodan marks the target until the end of his next turn.
Kodan uses spear twice. If he hits the same target with both attacks, the target is slowed (save ends).

hit.description: damage, plus 1 damage for each ally within 5 squares of Kodan.

effect.description: Close burst 5 (allies in the burst). Each target can shift up to 3 squares.

powers.name: Redeploy
powers.trigger: An enemy adjacent to Kodan and marked by him shifts away from him.

effect.description: Kodan charges an enemy other than the triggering enemy.
